{{Quote|We'll get some new gear and equipment. Pablo's pawnshop has everything a bounty hunter needs and more.|Cad Bane|<ref name="Friends and Enemies">{{TCW|Friends and Enemies}}</ref>}}
This '''pawn shop''' was owned by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] [[Pablo/Legends|Pablo]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. Assisted by a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pablo's Twi'lek partner/Legends|helper]], Pablo sold many different items, and was visited by a disguised [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], and [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]], the two former purchasing a helmet and a wide-brimmed hat. Bane noted that Pablo's supply of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] was not up to snuff, and a [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper helmet]] was dubiously on display inside. A [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]'s head was also in the shop.
